rationale: Price has collapsed from the session high of $18.26 to $16.91, sitting just 0.24% above today's low with strong downward momentum in the last five candles and is well below both VWAP ($17.68) and the 9-EMA ($17.21), suggesting sustained selling pressure. The risk/reward does not favor initiating either direction this late in a high-volatility session.
